role: Independent checker required by charter section A.8
blindingStatement: Derived entirely from live disk and the frozen 2026-08-23 census artifacts. No file under audit/campaign-16-phase-a-baseline-2026-08-26/ was opened before this file was written and hashed.
notInScope: A.1 (census baseline) — not named by the A.8 exit gate

a2.method: Two independent shell methods. (1) recursive fixed-string grep -rF over ALL files under banks/ including .DS_Store, banks-raw/ and case_sources/. (2) Node JSON parse of all 13 bundled banks plus a full recursive walk of every string value (144679 scanned) matched against the 13 target IDs. MCP repository search NOT used (Trap 1).
a2.positiveControl: The same grep located gpt_case_hipaa_disclosure_breach_01_bowtie and gpt_format15_vasa_previa_bleeding_bowtie in banks/gpt-canonical.json (6.8 MB) and gpt_case_gbs_respiratory_compromise_01_bowtie in banks/hard-cases-canonical.json, so the method demonstrably reads the large file and absence is a real negative rather than a silent skip.

a3.trap4Mitigation: BOTH named mitigations were used. (a) validate-bank across all 13 bundled banks: 13/13 OK, exit 0. (b) explicit-file path: the audit was invoked with --file once per bundled bank (26 argv tokens), routing to runExplicitFiles, which fails loud on any unloadable or schema-invalid file. Reported figures are taken from the explicit-file runs.
a3.banksIndependentlyEstablishedMethod: Separate script replicating loadBank semantics (parseBankText + validateBankObject rejectUnknownKeys:true) over readdir(banks) .json entries: 13 entries, 13 loaded and schema-valid, 0 failures. Established independently of the audit-reported file count (Trap 4).
a3.trap3Note: A strict exit status of 1 with revealsAllStages > 0 is the expected result per Trap 3, not a Phase A failure. Output was captured before inspecting exit status; no set -e abort occurred.
a3.coincidenceNote: The rederived revealsAllStages total is 451 and the distinct parent-case count is 93. These equal the 2026-07-19 / 2026-07-23 figures. Reported as a coincidence of measurement per A.3, NOT as confirmation of the historical population.

a5.convention: raw file-byte SHA-256 (distinct from the A.4.2 stable-payload convention)
a5.crossCheck: node crypto digests equal shasum -a 256 banks/*.json for all 13 files

corroboration.gptCanonicalDriftDecomposition: Exactly 7 question payloads in banks/gpt-canonical.json differ from c2ff546 (5 case_study and 2 matrix, all gpt_gap_2026_06_12_* / gpt_2026_06_13_*); question count unchanged at 760; meta unchanged; 0 added; 0 removed; and 0 of the changed IDs carry the _bowtie suffix. This is the June 13 matrix answer-mapping restoration and independently explains why the sole A.5 bank drift coexists with zero A.4.3 / A.4.4 / A.4.5 payload drift.
